Babe Ruth lays unconscious for 5 minutes after running into a concrete wall chasing a foul ball. He stayed in the game and had 2 more hits. D.C. 1924

On July 24, 1924 the Yankees were playing a doubleheader against the Washington Senators. In the fourth inning of the first game Joe Judge hit a ball just over the right-field line. Racing to make a catch, Ruth slammed into a concrete wall and was knocked unconscious for 5 minutes. Yankees’ trainer Doc Woods, rushed to him and poured icy water onto his face until he woke up.

A player so injured today would be taken to a hospital for neurological tests, but this was 1924 so Ruth went back into the game and recorded two more hits,

Also note that Ruth collapsed in front of the Black spectators section.of the racially segregated stadium and there may be a black soda vendor on the field looking over him as well (a basket of sodas are sitting on the step to the stands)..

King's College London - Scientists herald 'tipping point' in ability to predict academic achievement from DNA

The research shows that a genetic score comprising 20,000 DNA variants explains almost 10 per cent of the differences between children’s educational attainment at the age of 16.

The effect strength is far lower than I expected for all the celebrating the article does over the achievement. I don't care if it's one hundred times better than previous attempts by the same method, there's still a lot left to other factors (such as household environment, early nutrition, and a million other things).
People also tend to forget that chances if debilitating psychological problems increases with IQ as well. More intelligent does not directly translate into more evolutionarily fit humans.
To a small extent, but it's more of an exception than a rule. Japan's IQ average is 20 points over Europe and America, but they're doing quite well despite the potential 'handicap'.

As the article mentions twin studies have shown genetics to account for about 60% of academic achievement as a whole. This study managed to show 10% through the selection of a small number of common genetic markers. Genetic science (and human physiology for that matter) is still purely correlation based, but being able to correlate academic achievement with a small number of genetic markers does seem like quite the accomplishment.

It's also an achievement in terms of social things which destroys the platforms of both sides of the American political spectrum. In particular it's currently probably mostly right wingers who see this news favorably, yet provable genetic differences in performance capacity completely destroys the "Everybody can just pull themselves up by their bootstraps argument." It is a strong argument for more social equality. On the other hand the very thought that people of difference genetic backgrounds are provably different completely destroys any notion of political correctness on the left wing side. It also means having people of certain genetic backgrounds disproportionately represented in certain fields may not be because of "social bias" but a result of effective selection.
